title: Man shot by police on suicide mission: [FINAL C Edition]
article: The man shot dead by police in Langford Monday afternoon was on a suicide mission, say members of his family.
Joseph Pagnotta, 52, was shot after he continued to lunge at police with a knife, even after being shot with a TASER stun gun.
Pagnotta, a convicted drug dealer once set on fire by a disgruntled customer, struggled with drugs for the last 20 years, said his sister-in-law Rosanna Chartier.
